subtopic: Human Eye and Defects of Vision
stem:
Match the columns in the following table and explain them.

| Column 1 | Column 2 | Column 3 |
|---|---|---|
| Farsightedness | Nearby object can be seen clearly | Bifocal lens |
| Presbyopia | Far away object can be seen clearly | Concave lens |
| Nearsightedness | Problem of old age | Convex lens |

stem: At which position will you keep an object in front of a convex lens so as to get a real image of the same size as the object ? Draw a figure.
